# LZMA fixtures

`microlzma-small.bin.b64` was generated from
`src/lzms/testdata/lzms-small.txt` with XZ Utils commit
`3b1efb04d17c3a9ef7f473d73af13f1531428ffe`, the default LZMA preset, and a
32 KiB dictionary. The decoded 695-byte payload has SHA-256
`45d26bf8dc7eb183b106bccc03b928e711871ba48b4b2b9bc327eb5219ea58d8`;
the 208-byte MicroLZMA stream has SHA-256
`2d4653160bb24229f15e6b79f8e5250bf9e68264ad3cf930b16c1b1af6864190`.
